verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a feature-flag and experimentation SaaS platform, but the evidence never documents a self-hosted deployment of Statsig itself. Warehouse Native only lets Statsig's features run on top of your own data warehouse. That is an adjacent data-residency option, not self-hosting the core product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
